description: One place for Dataverse / Dynamics 365 security administration. Explore who has which security roles and teams, compare users, find which roles grant a privilege on a table, and spot forgotten users, roles and teams. Change security safely: assign roles to users and teams, manage team membership and clone a user's profile, with a review of every change first, an undo, and an optional restore file.
releaseNotes: 1.2.1: Fixes privileges for roles that sit in a child business unit. Their privileges live on the root role, so Explain access, A user's access, Two roles and Privileged users found none for them; each copy now uses its root role's privileges. A privilege that stands for the same action on several tables now counts for each table, and Explain access says how many roles it checked when it finds no route. 1.2.0: The menu is grouped by intent (Look up, Understand access, Compare, Review, Change) with foldable groups and a Find a screen box. New: Compare roles, and Business units (the hierarchy as a tree, merging the old Users by business unit). The Cleanup report can remove disabled users from teams and strip their roles, with the usual review and undo. A question-led Home page, a How it works line on every screen, empty states that say what to do, and privilege depths drawn with the Dynamics 365 icons everywhere. Explain access reads only the roles the selected users hold. Compare users always shows the business unit line. 1.1.0: New Explain access (why can this user do this?), What can a user do? (every table against the eight privileges, in the style of the Dynamics 365 security role editor) and Privileged users (roles that can delete across the organization and who holds them). 1.0.1: Packaging update only, no functional changes. 1.0.0: First release. Explore: users and teams, team members, users by role, users by business unit, privilege finder, compare users and a cleanup report. Change: assign roles to users and to teams, manage team membership and clone a user profile; every change is reviewed before it is applied and can be undone.
title: Security Toolkit
